segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְכׇל דָּבָר שֶׁאֵין עוֹשִׂין בּוֹ אוֹכֶל נֶפֶשׁ, מָקוֹם שֶׁמַּשְׂכִּירִין כְּיוֹצֵא בָּהֶן — אָסוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And» with regard to «any item that one does not use in the preparation of food,» in «a place where one rents» items «of that kind,» that item is «forbidden.» Meaning, one for whom benefit from another is forbidden by vow is prohibited from borrowing this type of item from the one who vowed and imposed the prohibition. This is because one can use the money saved by borrowing the item rather than renting it to purchase food.

moves.cueHe: וכל דבר שאין עושין בו אוכל נפש

positions.claim: Where such items are rented, borrowing them is forbidden to one vowed from food benefit
